risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Strategic risk flagged in MD&A opportunities-and-threats discussion as the company moves up the value chain into branded/private-label FMCG products
- Flagged alongside margin pressure and branding-capability needs as a strategic risk in the MD&A
- Global spunlace market is highly competitive with strong pressure on standard grades due to broad capacity availability in many regions
- Recent US trade tariff imposition and the Middle East war situation have created risks for the entire global market, to be watched closely
- Global wipes/nonwovens industry risk noted: regulatory tightening especially on disposables, and raw material volatility in nonwoven fabrics and chemicals
- Flagged as a risk to the global FMCG wipes/cosmetics segment amid the sustainability-led innovation trend
- Company's move into branded/private-label products requires branding capability the MD&A describes as still 'progressing', implying execution risk

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
